author: Stahly
description:
I've waited a long time for a redesign of MkIV power armour, and so have most Horus Heresy hobbyists. As a Sons of Horus collector, "Maximus" armour is as iconic as it gets. So the moment the Maximus Battle Group landed in my hands, I got straight to work painting a Tactical Squad. Here are the first five models, along with a breakdown of how I paint my grimdark Sons of Horus colour scheme.

The post Finally, plastic MkIV Legionaries for my Sons of Horus collection (showcase) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Finally, plastic MkIV Legionaries for my Sons of Horus collection (showcase)
